rows.note: Use this when leavening dough by adding yeast.

example.english: Before kneading the dough, remember to leaven it with yeast and let it rise.
example.traditional: 整麵糰之前，記住要落酵母，等佢發起。
example.jyutping: zing2 min6 tyun4 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 jiu3 lok6 haau1 mou5 dang2 keoi5 faat3 hei2

rows.note: Use this when the leavening agent is baking powder rather than yeast.

example.english: You don't need yeast to leaven the cake; just add baking powder.
example.traditional: 焗蛋糕唔使酵母，落發粉就得喇。
example.jyutping: guk6 daan6 gou1 m4 sai2 gaau3 mou5 lok6 faat3 fan2 zau6 dak1 laa3
